key_highlights: ASX slumping as bond yields spike amid global bond market turmoil; Wall Street weakness spilling into Sydney
Australian unemployment hits 5-year high yet RBA signals continued rate hikes — a stagflationary signal
AUD 'pulverised' by US dollar strength; Trump trade policy (diesel export ban) creating export headwinds
Property market over halfway to largest 40-year correction; rising listings and falling demand pressuring prices
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need, raising fiscal sustainability concerns
Mining exploration active: Rio2 Peruvian copper drill, Forrestania WA gold resource >210k oz, Lindian rare earths nearing production
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving fees; consumer sector under pressure
Energy sector in 'hysteria' mode; data centre boom straining grid; nuclear ban debate intensifies

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust (copper, gold, rare earths) but macro headwinds from weak AUD, Trump trade policy, and bond yield spike pressuring large-cap miners
sectors.implications: Small/mid-cap explorers (Forrestania, Lindian, Auric, Sarytogan) benefit from project milestones; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from diesel export ban and global demand uncertainty

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite 5-year high unemployment creates NIM pressure; property correction threatens mortgage book quality; Intergenerational Report flags fiscal stress
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising credit loss provisions from property downturn; bond yield spike compresses equity valuations; rate hike cycle may peak but property risk lingers

sectors.trend: Energy 'hysteria' accelerating; data centre demand straining supply; $1B energy showdown at historic Sydney site; nuclear ban debate; Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian exports
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WGC.AX, SXG.AX benefit from energy scarcity narrative; but diesel export ban (headline 55) is a direct revenue threat to oil & gas producers; grid infrastructure spend supports construction names

sectors.trend: Consumer stress acute: >50% of renters financially struggling, property correction, Jetstar industrial action, Ozempic disrupting food demand
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX, CCL.AX face margin pressure; Jetstar (JQZ.AX) industrial action escalates; McDonald's (MCD) Ozempic pivot signals structural shift in food demand

sectors.trend: Largest house price falls in 40 years underway; rising listings, falling demand; Dusty Martin $20m portfolio haircut; CBD tower listed at $40m
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICOL.AX) under pressure from falling occupier demand and rising vacancy; residential REITs face capital value erosion; commercial property (CBD tower listing) signals structural oversupply

sectors.trend: AI chip competition intensifying globally (Nvidia, AMD, Intel); Salesforce product launch; CSL.AX steady but Ozempic boom reshaping pharma demand
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX tech exposure; CSL.AX benefits from healthcare demand but faces Ozempic competitive dynamics; global AI capex cycle supports indirect demand for Australian data centre infrastructure

Stagflation risk: 5-year high unemployment + RBA hiking
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and equity outflows

Trump trade policy (diesel ban) as structural export risk
Intergenerational Report 2026 signalling fiscal reform urgency

Consumer financial stress across renters and middle-income cohorts

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike / global bond market turmoil
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration and floating-rate instruments; hedge equity with inverse bond ETFs
Overweight inflation-linked assets (gold miners, energy); underweight rate-sensitive growth; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and Trump trade policy (diesel export ban)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; diversify export revenue; monitor US-AU trade negotiations; favour domestic-revenue companies
Reduce REIT and residential exposure; monitor bank credit loss provisions; favour commercial REITs in growth corridors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply crisis and grid strain
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy producers and grid infrastructure; monitor AEMO capacity warnings; consider nuclear policy shift as long-term catalyst

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand erosion and industrial action
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour essential-staple names; avoid discretionary consumer; monitor Jetstar (JQZ.AX) wage settlement

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper explorers on project milestones
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania >210k oz WA gold, Lindian rare earths nearing production, Sarytogan 452m copper — de-risked exploration with inflation hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy producers and grid infrastructure names
opportunities.rationale: Energy hysteria and data centre demand create structural scarcity; nuclear ban lift would be re-rating catalyst

opportunities.recommendation: Position in large-cap gold as bond turmoil hedge
opportunities.rationale: Rising yields and AUD weakness support gold; Auric high-grade discovery adds sector momentum

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and residential property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year high price falls, rising listings, falling demand; credit risk building in bank books

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive growth and discretionary consumer
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yield spike compresses multiples; consumer stress (renters, Jetstar action) pressures earnings
AUD 'pulverised' by US boom; Trump diesel ban threatens energy export revenue

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend weakness over 1–3 months as bond yields remain elevated, RBA maintains hawkish bias, and property correction deepens. ^AXJO under pressure; ^AORD more resilient. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US trade policy developments.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots post-unemployment peak and property stabilises. Intergenerational Report 2026 tax reform could support fiscal credibility. Mining exploration pipeline (copper, gold, rare earths) provides structural upside. Nuclear policy shift would be a major re-rating event for energy sector.
key_catalysts: RBA rate decision and statement (hawkish hold vs pivot)

Energy policy / nuclear ban debate outcome
AUD/USD trajectory and US Fed policy
